name: Spacecraft Systems Fundamentals
summary: An end-to-end view of a spacecraft: payload and bus, the subsystems, how they interact and the budgets that tie them together.

topics.name: Subsystem overview: ADCS, propulsion, power, thermal, communications, C&DH, structures
Mass, power, data, pointing and delta-v budgets
Launch vehicle interfaces and the payload user's guide
Mission phases: launch, early operations, commissioning, operations, disposal
Reliability and redundancy at spacecraft level
Case studies: a communications satellite, an Earth observer, a planetary probe
